# Cotelo

> Cotelo provides agentic AI that automates conference planning. AI agents find sponsors that match an event's brand.

Planners describe their event in plain words. Cotelo's agents research and rank sponsors and present options. The planner approves every decision.

## How it works

- Brief: the planner describes topic, audience, size, dates, budget and brand.
- Review and approve: the planner sees a ranked shortlist of sponsors, approves what fits, and changes what does not.
- Share in one place: approved sponsors are published on one page, so no one has to collect information from separate sources.

## Pages

- [Cotelo home](https://coteloai.com/): overview, how it works and features.
